    "00:00-00:23: No identifiable vessel participating in the later transfer is clearly visible; background vessels cannot establish its starting contents.",
    "00:24: Source A appears in the server's hand: round transparent glass coffee carafe with black top and handle; dark liquid occupies roughly half the bulb.",
    "00:25: Source A held upright above the counter; same glass body and black hardware, dark contents still approximately half-full.",
    "00:26-00:27.083: Source A held near the customer, not visibly pouring in the wide view; substantial dark contents remain. Destination B is partly concealed by his hands and counter objects; initial fill unknown.",
    "00:27-00:27.125 close-up: Source A has the same rounded glass body and black hardware; dark liquid fills approximately the lower half to two-thirds of the bulb. No stream yet.",
    "00:27-00:27.125 close-up: Destination B is an opaque white ceramic mug, partly covered by the customer's hand; rim visible, initial liquid level concealed.",
    "00:28: Source A tilts and releases a brown stream from its mouth; the bulk contents remain dark brown-black, consistent with the thinner backlit stream. Exact volume is unmeasurable at this tilt.",
    "00:28: Destination B rests upright on the counter with its rounded handle on the left; the stream enters its opening. Opaque walls and low viewing angle conceal the rising surface.",
    "00:29: Source A continues pouring brown liquid and remains substantially filled; the carafe moves vertically, preventing comparison by screen height alone.",
    "00:29: Destination B retains its white ceramic body, size, rim and left handle; stream enters the mug, with no visible overflow or measurable fill level.",
    "00:30: Source A continues pouring; dark liquid occupies a slightly shallower visible portion of the tilted bulb than at 00:29. No change in material type is visible.",
    "00:30: Destination B continues receiving the stream; body and handle remain consistent, liquid surface still hidden and no visible spill.",
    "00:31: Source A returns toward upright and the stream stops; substantial dark liquid remains. The apparent surface height changes with orientation, so this is not a reliable refill measurement.",
    "00:31: Destination B remains upright after the pour, containing received coffee; final fill level is concealed below the rim.",
    "00:32.292: Source A is carried away to the right, still a round glass carafe with black hardware and approximately half a bulb of dark liquid; it was never visibly emptied.",
    "00:32.292: Destination B remains on the counter with unchanged white body and left handle; contents hidden, no further transfer visible.",
    "00:36-00:44.917: Customer holds a matching white mug at the counter; presumed B, with continuity across a cut rather than uniquely identifying markings. Contents and fill level are hidden throughout.",
    "00:44.958-00:51.333: Customer's mug is distant and partly obscured; contents and level cannot be resolved. A separate white mug stands on the foreground kitchen ledge, with unknown contents and no visible transfer.",
    "00:59.875-01:09.042: A white mug stands before the customer in the wide shot; presumed B, contents and fill level hidden. No carafe-to-mug transfer is shown.",
    "01:09.083-01:11: Customer's white mug is upright beside the plate and then grasped; its ceramic body and loop handle remain recognizable, but its liquid level is not visible.",
    "01:12: Customer lifts his white mug while the server holds another white mug; both are opaque, with unknown fill levels. No liquid passes between them.",
    "01:13-01:17.542: A white mug remains in the customer's hand and then at the counter. Handling and occlusion limit identification between the similar mugs; no visible emptying, refill or contents change is established.",
    "01:17.583-01:26.750: White mugs are intermittently visible around the two people at the counter; contents and fill levels remain concealed, with no visible pouring.",
    "01:26.792-01:35.208: Customer and server each hold a separate white ceramic mug. Both retain loop-handled mug forms; neither liquid surface is clearly exposed, so no fill-level comparison is possible.",

    "01:52-01:58: Crockery becomes carried, occluded or too distant to identify individually; no measurable later state of Source A or Destination B is available.",
